name: Roommate Benefits: The Governor's Son
overview: Megan hid her heiress identity for love, only to be betrayed by the boyfriend she gave everything to. After their breakup, she unexpectedly ends up living under the same roof as Cole Warner—the governor's sexy, rebellious badboy son. What starts as constant clashes soon turns into an irresistible attraction neither of them can escape.
